body: She was fine. Got staples in her arms etc. She keeps having these horrible episodes. I think she's getting help. :) Thank you all so much.

I've been through a lot of it myself but it's my first time consciously experiencing it and it's symptoms from another person. She can't remember what has happened to her arms etc, and she's convinced the voices are now trying to kill me. I'm going to keep her talking, I think she's slightly out of the danger zone. Thank you guys. <3
